description: Beta-barrel proteins are so far found only in outer membranes of gram-negative bacteria, cell wall of gram-positive bacteria, and outer membranes of mitochondria and chloroplasts. All beta-barrel transmembrane proteins have simplest up-and-down topology, which may reflect their common evolutionary origin and similar folding mechanism.
title: Beta Barrel Transmembrane Proteins
keywords_string: transmembrane, protein, beta barrel, beta, sheet
